description: FIELD: A comprehensive FarmIng Electrical LoaD measurements dataset from 30 three-phase dairy farms in Germany is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Apostolos Vavouris et al. The industrial sector, which is characterised by complex and diverse equipment and processes, is a core contributor to carbon emissions. Agriculture, in particular, has seen an increase in carbon dioxide emissions, in contrast to methane and nitrous oxide emissions, due to the increased use of novel, energy-intensive agricultural technology. Coverage: national (DE); published in 2025. Formats: ZIP, TXT, CSV, Image. The data are held in University of Strathclyde and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: -1627MB. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
